body:
## Summary
- Add Shift-click handling for saved visualization presets to open the rename dialog instead of loading the preset.
- Add Shift-click handling for saved pipelines to open the pipeline rename dialog instead of loading the pipeline.
- Cover both interactions with Cypress regression tests.

Fixes Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization#188

## Verification
- `npm run typecheck`
- `npm test -- --runInBand`
- Targeted Cypress coverage:
  - `cypress/e2e/preset-management.cy.js` includes `opens the rename dialog when a saved preset is shift-clicked` and passed during the broader preset spec run.
  - A temporary isolated Cypress run of `opens the rename dialog when a saved pipeline is shift-clicked` passed: 1 passing, 27 pending.

## Notes
A broader Cypress run against `cypress/e2e/preset-management.cy.js,cypress/e2e/pipeline-mode.cy.js` was also attempted after starting a repo-root static server. It confirmed the new preset Shift-click test passed, but the full run had unrelated existing/flaky failures:
- `Preset Management > uses skip dialog mode with numbered default names`: sidebar had `pointer-events: none` when clicking `#savePresetBtn`.
- `Pipeline Mode` had unrelated failures in existing scheduling/stage tests before reaching the end of the full suite.
